Messages.Author: lisa
Messages.Body:
Hi everyone!

In a game that I played with my happy gentle *sarcasm* ally deck, one of my
ally (Nephandus mage: damage= 1 R) played Lucky Blow to do 2 damage (at
close range) to the opposing Vampire that would get some sleep in the
precious torpor. But the opponent declared: the damage is 1R so he can deal
only 1 with a Lucky Blow because by default his hand damage is 0. >:-[

I believe that a card that deal 1 R damage do indeed inflict 1 hand damage
if at close range.

Example of cards that deal 1R damage: Aurora Van Brande Paladin-LASOMBRA,
Lazarus-TREMERE, ALLIES: The Slashers, Talak the Immortal, Nephandus, Rom
Gypsy, Tara The Hollow One, Order of Hermes Cabal, Thadius Zho (2R), Outcast
Mage (2R).

So the question is:
At close range, if I use a Lucky Blow (+1 hand damage) on a minion that
normally deals 1R damage, do the minion deal:
1) 1 damage?
2) or 2 damage?
------------------------------
Now, about Nephandus (mage, ally).

Am I correct to assume that he reduce the damage an opposing minion will
deal to him by 1 during combat:
so -1 damage to him at each strike resolution?

Mmmmmmm .... Trap ...... :-)
-----------------------------

Thanks!

Messages.Author: Dhar...@yahoo.com
Messages.Body:
"lisa" wrote:
> So the question is:
> At close range, if I use a Lucky Blow (+1 hand damage) on a minion that
> normally deals 1R damage, do the minion deal:
> 1) 1 damage?

> 2) or 2 damage?
> ------------------------------
> Now, about Nephandus (mage, ally).

An ally is assumed to have 0 hand damage unless specifically stated
otherwise...Muddled Vampire Hunter, for example. An ally cannot
use a ranged damaged attack if the opposing vampire plays Immortal
Grapple. So in the case of Nephandus, a Lucky Blow card will give
him a hand damage of 1, because his hand damage is a base of 0.

Hope this helps,

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
James Coupe <ve...@obeah.demon.co.uk> wrote:
> lisa <bob...@globetrotter.net> writes

> >So the question is:
> >At close range, if I use a Lucky Blow (+1 hand damage) on a minion that
> >normally deals 1R damage, do the minion deal:
> >1) 1 damage?
>

> 1 damage. When allies say nothing about hand damage, or only say about
> ranged damage, they have 0 hand damage. So 0+1

Correct. If he had chosen 'hands' as his strike, he would have dealt
zero damage, since he has no hand strike/strength listed on his card (and
an Ally's strength defaults to zero). [6.4.5] If he had chosen his innate
'1R'-dealing strike, he would not be striking with hands, since a strike
that deals R damage is not a hand strike (by default).

* Hand Strike: any non-ranged, non-weapon strike that deals damage based
on the striking minion's hand damage, or any minion's non-ranged
damage-dealing innate strike. [LSJ 970224]

Lucky Blow allows you to "use your hand or melee weapon at +1 damage".
If you are using hands, your do your base hand damage (zero) +1 damage,
for a total of one damage.

> >2) or 2 damage?
> >------------------------------
> >Now, about Nephandus (mage, ally).
> >

> >Am I correct to assume that he reduce the damage an opposing minion will
> >deal to him by 1 during combat:
> >so -1 damage to him at each strike resolution?
>
> I think so, yes.

Correct.

Nephandus (Mage) [SAB] - ally (TreA) (2)
* Each strike or other damaging effect made against Nephandus by the
opposing minion is at -1 damage. [LSJ 970224]

Messages.Author: Derek S. Ray
Messages.Body:
On 2 Mar 1999 01:37:59 GMT, ml...@netusa1.net (Colin Gunning) wrote:

>I always thought 1r meant 1 close or 1 ranged...where is this ruling found?If
>this is corect then steal blood or guns do ranged only dam ?

You are correct in your first assumption. 1R means strike: one point
of damage, *also* usable at long range. You may be confused because
in this thread we're combining it with the effects of Immortal
Grapple, which state that "only hand strikes" may be used for the
current round. The rules section LSJ quoted clarifies that ranged
strikes are NEVER hand damage, and so a strike for 1R, even though not
specified what type of strike it is, is definitely not hand damage.
It doesn't mean that they can't be used at close range if you AREN'T
Immortally Grappled. (Except when card text overrides, such as Thrown
Sewer Lid.)

Messages.Author: Lupus Australis
Messages.Body:
On Mon, 1 Mar 1999, Bryan Nelson wrote:

> With the logic you supply I have to agree with you.
>

> Colin Gunning wrote:
>
> > I always thought 1r meant 1 close or 1 ranged...where is this ruling found?If
> > this is corect then steal blood or guns do ranged only dam ?

Ranged damage *does* work at close range. That is not the issue.

The issue is that ranged strikes do not meet the definition of "hand
damage". That being the case, an ally who has "1R damage" as his inherent
strike does not have any "hand damage". AFAIK, a ruling was made that
allies without a specified hand damage have a default value of 0.

Such an ally at close range could choose to use it's inherent 1R strike to
hit for one damage, but this is not hand damage and cannot be combined
with Lucky Blow, or used while immortally grappled. If it used Lucky
Blow, it would strike for 0+1=1 damage.
